request.spec:
Show for the sheet the due of OPEN and PENDING claims that count by age, as the people's age
buckets added up (0 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 or more days), not trimmed.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show for the sheet the due of OPEN and PENDING claims that count by age, as the people's age
buckets added up (0 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 or more days), not trimmed.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The sheet's totals panel now shows the sheet-wide due of open and pending claims in three age groups: 0 to 30 days, 31 to 60, and 61 or more. Each figure adds up every person's figure for that age group, with none trimmed off. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

- **`src/main/frontend/features/claims/claims.ts`**: `useSheetTotals` now also returns these three totals. It adds up each person's result from `agedCents`, which already gives the figures shown in each person's row. So the sheet totals use exactly the same rules, including which claims count and how a claim's age is measured.
- **`src/main/frontend/features/claims/rollup.slot.tsx`**: a "Due by age" line shows the three totals under the test's new anchors: `rollup-aged-0-30`, `rollup-aged-31-60` and `rollup-aged-61`.

No server, database or audit-file changes were needed, because the sheet's other totals are already worked out on the front end the same way.
